# <dl-item>

Groups a dt/dd pair within a description list for built-in layout variants.

- CSS-only custom element. Works without JavaScript.
- Documentation: https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/elements/custom-elements/dl-item/
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Example

```html
<dl data-variant="horizontal" data-bordered>
  <dl-item>
    <dt>Full Name</dt>
    <dd>Alexandra Chen</dd>
  </dl-item>
  <dl-item>
    <dt>Email</dt>
    <dd>alexandra.chen@example.com</dd>
  </dl-item>
  <dl-item>
    <dt>Role</dt>
    <dd>Senior Engineer</dd>
  </dl-item>
  <dl-item>
    <dt>Status</dt>
    <dd>Active</dd>
  </dl-item>
</dl>
```
